maddeler.e:
نحتضر (form VIII)
# نَحْتَضِرُ (naḥtaḍiru) /naħ.ta.dˤi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# نُحْتَضَرُ (nuḥtaḍaru) /nuħ.ta.dˤa.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
# نَحْتَضِرَ (naḥtaḍira) /naħ.ta.dˤi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# نُحْتَضَرَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
